# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
# web-blob
tap id:case-web-blob
expect blob.size=6
expect blob.type=text/plain
expect blob.text=abcdef
expect blob.empty=0|""
expect blob.badType=""
expect blob.utf8=5
expect blob.stringParts=1xtrue
expect blob.endings=4
expect blob.slice=bc
expect blob.sliceNegative=ef
expect blob.sliceClamp=ef
expect blob.sliceEmpty=0
expect blob.sliceType=""|x/y
expect blob.arrayBuffer=true|6|99
expect blob.bytes=[97,98,99]
expect blob.stream=abcdef
expect blob.binary=[0,255]
expect file.fields=[greeting.txt,text/plain,5,1700000000000,""]
expect file.isBlob=[true,true]
expect file.text=hello
expect file.defaultLastModified=true
expect file.sliceIsBlob=false|true
expect file.nameKept=a/b.txt
expect form.get=[1,null]
expect form.getAll=[1,2]
expect form.has=[true,false]
expect form.blobEntry=File(blob,text/csv,3)
expect form.blobName=File(q.bin,,1)
expect form.file=File(greeting.txt,text/plain,5)
expect form.fileContent=q
expect form.coerce=string
expect form.set=[9]
expect form.keys=[a,c,d]
expect form.entries=[a:9,c:File(q.bin,,1),d:File(greeting.txt,text/plain,5)]
expect form.values=[9,File(q.bin,,1),File(greeting.txt,text/plain,5)]
expect form.iterator=3
expect form.forEach=[a,c,d]
expect done
covers [globals] Blob
covers [globals] File
covers [globals] FormData
# web-control-flow
tap id:case-web-control-flow
# If: children while `when` is truthy, else `else`; a falsy number shows nothing.
expect If: children
absent If: else branch
absent If: count is 0
tap id:toggle
expect If: else branch
absent If: children
tap id:toggle
expect If: children
absent If: else branch
tap id:count
expect If: count is 1
tap id:count
expect If: count is 2
# Each, kept by item: order on screen, a row's own state, index().
expect Alpha at 0 pressed 0
expect Beta at 1 pressed 0
expect Gamma at 2 pressed 0
frame id:row-a 0 0 390 20
frame id:row-b 0 20 390 20
frame id:row-c 0 40 390 20
tap id:row-a
expect Alpha at 0 pressed 1
tap id:reverse
expect Gamma at 0 pressed 0
expect Beta at 1 pressed 0
expect Alpha at 2 pressed 1
frame id:row-c 0 0 390 20
frame id:row-a 0 40 390 20
tap id:drop
absent Beta at 1 pressed 0
expect Alpha at 1 pressed 1
frame id:row-a 0 20 390 20
tap id:add
expect Delta at 2 pressed 0
frame id:row-d 0 40 390 20
# Each with a key function: new items with the same keys keep their rows.
expect One at 0 pressed 0
expect Two at 1 pressed 0
tap id:row-k1
expect One at 0 pressed 1
tap id:rekey
expect Two again at 0 pressed 0
expect One again at 1 pressed 1
frame id:row-k1 0 20 390 20
# Each with key="index": rows stay by position, item() changes.
expect red at 0 pressed 0
expect green at 1 pressed 0
tap id:row-w0
expect red at 0 pressed 1
tap id:recolor
expect blue at 0 pressed 1
expect green at 1 pressed 0
expect yellow at 2 pressed 0
absent red at 0 pressed 1
# Each of null shows nothing.
absent Maybe: filled
tap id:fill
expect Maybe: filled
tap id:fill
absent Maybe: filled
covers [globals] If
covers [globals] Each
